scenes.heading: Setting boundaries around hours and availability

sents.d: Setting boundaries around hours and availability
Clear availability boundaries protect against being treated as always-on.

Remote, flexible-seeming work can create an expectation of constant availability if boundaries aren't explicitly set — clarifying specific working hours and response time expectations early prevents this from becoming assumed.

Communicating time zone differences clearly, if relevant, and setting explicit expectations about weekend or after-hours availability (or lack thereof) protects your personal time without seeming uncommitted.

Most clients respect clearly stated boundaries far more than vague availability that later needs to be walked back — setting them upfront is easier than renegotiating them after unclear expectations have already formed.

take: State your hours and response times from day one.
